decision: test-scenes/src/lib.rs builders are fixture data, not assertions. For 11.6.6/11.7.2 evidence, count only their linked consumer tests and distinguish backend agreement from source-derived expected values.
basis: Most headless cross-backend tests assert inter-renderer agreement; the direct PDF tests in transparency_groups.rs and literal CPU renderer tests provide the stronger conformance witnesses.

decision: The 11.6.6 repeated-Do sentence has no discriminating named assertion among sampled tests. A backdrop-sensitive non-isolated Screen group can test one invocation over the changed backdrop with a simple independent channel value.
basis: Source final paragraph at printed p.423 / physical p.438: repeated Do calls shall each be a separate transparency group; Table 145 supplies the false/default non-isolated behavior and §11.3.5.2 defines Screen. The test detects stale reuse of a composited result, not backdrop-independent content caching with fresh compositing.

decision: The sampled 11.7.2 and soft-mask tests use useful literal or paired expectations; recommendations that group color spaces should be CIE-based or usually linear do not mandate reader rejection of other spaces.
basis: §11.7.2's wording and notes explicitly distinguish `shall` conversion/inheritance behavior from `should` and usual-practice recommendations.

decision: Issue #134 modifies Table 145's /CS remapping authority to the transparency group's own resource dictionary. Issues #619 carets on the same physical page are Table 143 mask-image deprecation notes and must not be attributed to 11.6.6.
basis: Primary annotations and the checked page-location/range analysis in doc/errata-read.md.

decision: Soft_masks.rs has 11.7 intersections but remains mainly a §11.5 soft-mask derivation suite; avoid crediting it as general 11.7 coverage or repeating mask-only issues owned by viewer agent.
basis: Test names and asserted outputs show some group color conversion/overprinting routes; section ownership in the comments and source establishes the mask value calculations separately.
